featured.title: Lenskart Shareholders Letter Q1FY27.pdf
featured.description:
An exciting start to FY27 as we publish our Q1 results: https://lnkd.in/gFw35RER

A third more revenue. Nearly 3x PAT.

Q1 FY27 Key Numbers:

Revenue: ₹2,714 Cr | +33.6% YoY
EBITDA: ₹589 Cr | 21.7% margin
PAT: ₹228 Cr | +182% YoY

Q1 PAT of ₹228 Cr - compared with ₹530 Cr for the whole of FY26.

The big story this quarter is International. Revenue grew 38%, with EBITDA (pre-IndAS 116) margin crossing 10%. Owndays continues to strengthen in Japan, while Meller’s Paris store is seeing queues daily, with London next. Meller is tracking towards a ~$70M global brand.

And the engine in India keeps getting stronger:
• 0.7 Cr eye tests, up 39.8%
• Roughly 35,000 Indians discover every day at Lenskart that they need vision correction
• 18.3% India SSSG
• 70%+ product margin for the first time
• 80,000+ sign-ups for B by Lenskart, with smart glasses now shipping everyday
• Self-eye testing has entered pilot stores

The last one year has made one thing very clear to me:

We have to build the infrastructure for vision care. You cannot train your way to a billion eye tests. You have to engineer your way there.

AI + eye care + data + smart glasses gives us the opportunity to fundamentally expand access to vision.

Grateful to every customer, every Lenskartian and our shareholders.

Still very early. Still lots to learn.
Still Day Zero. 🙏

14 years to get here. Still feels like Day Zero!
Q4 and full-year FY26 results are out - our first year as a public company. Grateful to 20,000+ team members across 30+ nationalities who made this possible.

Q4:
• Revenue: +41%
• EBITDA: nearly doubled
• PAT (adj): 2.6x last year
• India same-store sales growth: 24%

FY26:
• Revenue: Rs 9,002 crore (+32%)
• EBITDA: nearly doubled
• PAT (adj): Rs 530 crore - 2.5x last year
• 23.8 million eye tests (+48.5%) - half of them first-time
• 603 new stores added
• Operating Cash Flow: Rs. 887 crore

But this is not the peak.

We are serving 50 million people in a world where billions need better vision. The problem is big and getting bigger - and as we go deeper, the opportunity widens. Smart glasses have opened an entirely new dimension over and above.

And AI has given us wings we have been waiting for.

Every eye test, every transaction, every frame tried on - it all generates data. That data now compounds on itself. Lenskart is no longer just an eyewear company. We are an eyewear + data company.

We're building for the next billion. The best is yet to come.

Detailed Shareholder Letter: https://lnkd.in/g_-YQchq

Grateful
- Peyush

It's past 11 PM on March 31st.
We should probably be asleep, but tonight, we couldn't wait any longer.

We've been working on something for a while now.
Quietly. Nervously, if I'm honest.

Because building glasses is something we know.
Building what comes next - we're still figuring that out.

B by Lenskart is live on early access.

We wanted B to feel like glasses first. Not a gadget. Not a statement. Just a beautiful, comfortable pair of glasses - at 40 grams - with a Sony camera and Snapdragon inside - that happens to carry the future in it.

Hands-free photos and videos. Immersive audio for music and calls. Conversational AI in 40+ languages - still early, honestly, but already surprising us every day. Japanese blue light lenses in every pair.

We have a lot ahead of us - better conversations, better battery, health and nutrition, and so much more we're dreaming about. This is just the beginning.

But here's what matters most to us.
When you buy B, you can walk into any of our 3,000+ stores. Get a real eye test. A real prescription. Talk to a real person who'll make sure your glasses fit and serve you for years. That's not a feature. That's just who we are.

This is one of the most ambitious things we've ever attempted - and an honest invitation to build it together with you.

To everyone who's walked into a Lenskart store, trusted us with their eyes, believed in what we're building -

This one is for you.
We went beyond. Come join us.

👉 https://lnkd.in/gFDxbXwP

#ShotOnB

Today we publish our Q3 FY26 Results.

This quarter feels special ...
- Revenue grew 37% YoY.
- EBITDA crossed 20% for the first time.
- PAT tripled.
- Net Promoter Score reached 81

But what makes it truly different isn’t just the financials.
We conducted 6.3 million eye tests this quarter - nearly 1/2 got access to vision care for the first-time.

Every eye test expands the market.
We are not splitting TAM. We are creating it.

This quarter reinforces something we’ve believed for years:
When AI becomes the operating system of a company, growth and profitability stop being trade-offs - they start compounding together.

The world is changing faster than ever because of AI.
What was not possible a year ago is possible today.
What seems ambitious today will feel basic tomorrow.

At Lenskart, what looks like acceleration is actually years of patient investment in technology finally compounding at scale.

AI is expanding access through remote optometry.
It is predicting store performance before we open.
It is personalizing frame recommendations in real time.
And it is learning with every transaction.

International business is scaling strongly and tracking ahead of where India was at a similar stage.

Meller is unlocking fashion sunglasses globally - showing how our platform can scale digital-first brands across markets.

And with upcoming B smart glasses soft launch, we are taking our first step from eyewear to wearable intelligence.

While this was a strong quarter, we continue to build with a decade-scale lens ✈️ 

The runway is long. 
The moat is widening.
It is still Day Zero toward Vision for Billion!

Detailed Shareholder Letter here: https://lnkd.in/gb8ZmNWW

Thank you for trusting us with both your vision and your capital.
— Peyush

Morning 7 AM experiments with B 👓🤖
The future’s getting ready… coming soon for all. 😊

A candid conversation with @iamadityaghosh

As part of taking our #hustlr movement (of enabling people to do more and be more) to the next level beyond just selling glasses, I want to share with you some special conversations with few hustlers I have personally learnt a lot from ... these conversations shape me, challenge me, allow me to think bigger, different, introspect, learn and improve every day.

These are not just another scripted interview...it is a regular conversation that I am learning from, like I have been doing all these years, and we are recording and sharing it with our larger group of hustlers.... because not everyone is as privileged as I am :(

First conversation I am sharing today is with one of my favorite magical people leader Aditya Ghosh. It took me almost 4 years to convince him to take out regular time for me (persistence paid off :) ...having seen what our travel experience used to be in those days, I always admired what Aditya had built in Indigo and now Akasa. It is special and 10X and not easy to do as I know from my first-hand experience. And lastly what was special to me was he had never run an airline or large organisation before (just like me:)...he was a lawyer who hustled and created one of the most successful airline stories globally.

So, learn as much as you can and Keep Hustling & Keep Dreaming!

Every one has a right to see well.... especially our children, who are future of India. Without vision these children can't learn and grow and realise their full potential. 

@lenskartfoundation it is our mission to give this basic right to all underprivileged children. 

Join us in our mission ...by just spreading awareness and taking an  underprivileged child around you for a free eye test at most optical store including a lenskart store. It does not cost anything. 

You can also buy them a pair of glasse or  get them a free pair of eyeglasses at any of the @lenskartfoundation centres or by mailing us at 
help@lenskartfoundation.com ...and we will arrange a free pair for them. 

Our current 2 centres are at: 

1) A-49-50, Gali No. 1 Lokpriya Vihar, Khora Colony Distt. Ghaziabad (UP)201010.

2) TA – 204, 1st Floor, Guru Ravidas Marg, Tughlakabad Extension, New Delhi, Delhi 110019
1800 103 4683 https://g.co/kgs/5nmnvo

Nice surprise at the Ahmedabad store today 🇳🇱
Roelof van der Merwe & Michael Levitt walked in looking for Meller — they’d picked it up earlier in Amsterdam too 😄

Earlier today, we spoke about our Q3 Results - growth, margins and AI. It’s been a long day - earnings call, discussions, travel.

Before heading to the airport, I stopped by our flagship store at Ambience Mall. The store was quiet. The team had just wrapped up.

And in that silence, you realize something simple:
Companies don’t compound. People do.

Behind every eye test, every store opening, every product launch - there are teams showing up every single day with discipline and belief.

As AI reshapes the world around us, one thing remains constant: culture and commitment matter more than ever.

Grateful to our ground teams across India and internationally. The numbers are theirs.

Sharing a few thoughts from the floor. 

If you want a full glimpse of how we're doing, I'm sharing our shareholder letter here too: https://assets.lenskart.com/documents/2026/02/11/Reg30-ShareholderLetter.pdf
